Name: Jubal
Summary: Jubal was the son of Lamech and Adah, and the father of all who play the harp and flute.
KeyStory: Jubal is remembered as the first musician, the beginning of humanity's gift of music.
RelatedPeople: Lamech, Son of Methusael; Adah, Wife of Lamech; Jabal
LifeLesson: Music itself is a gift from God, given to humanity from the very beginning.
